tasks.label: Build RetroBrowser
args: "call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\VC98\Bin\vcvars32.bat" && cl.exe /nologo /Fe:deploy/RetroBrowser.exe /Fo:obj/ /EHsc /MT /Zi /Od /W3 /D WIN32 /D _WINDOWS /D _MBCS /D WINVER=0x0410 /D _WIN32_WINNT=0x0410 /D _WIN32_WINDOWS=0x0410 /D _WIN32_IE=0x0500 /I src/browser /I src/browser/core /I libs/libjpeg/include src/browser/core/stdafx.cpp src/browser/core/main.cpp src/browser/ui/ui.cpp src/browser/renderer/renderer.cpp src/browser/parser/parser.cpp src/browser/network/network.cpp /link /SUBSYSTEM:WINDOWS /MACHINE:X86 /DEBUG /PDB:deploy/RetroBrowser.pdb /INCREMENTAL:NO kernel32.lib user32.lib gdi32.lib comctl32.lib shell32.lib ws2_32.lib advapi32.lib comdlg32.lib libs/libjpeg/lib/jpeg.lib"

tasks.label: Clean Build Artifacts
args: Remove-Item -Path obj/* -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path deploy/*.exe,deploy/*.pdb,deploy/*.ilk -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Build artifacts cleaned successfully' -ForegroundColor Green

tasks.label: Deploy to Win98 (Manual)
args: Write-Host '======================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host 'DEPLOYMENT INSTRUCTIONS FOR WIN98' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '======================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '1. Copy deploy/RetroBrowser.exe to Win98 machine' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '2. Ensure Win98 has network connectivity to proxy server' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '3. Configure proxy host IP in Win98 (default: 127.0.0.1:8080)' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '4. Run RetroBrowser.exe on Win98' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Current build location:' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '  ${workspaceFolder}/deploy/RetroBrowser.exe' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'NOTE: This is a STATIC binary with /MT flag.' -ForegroundColor Magenta; Write-Host '      No external DLL dependencies required!' -ForegroundColor Magenta; Write-Host ''
